degree_rationale: The Father's Five emanations 'one beside another' — Ambassador from mind, Mother of Life from thought, Beloved from teaching, Virgin from counsel, etc. Treats the inner relation of emanations to the Father's five members.
direction_rationale: Inward intellectual reception of how emanations correlate with the Father's interior members — a contemplative correlation rather than an outward action.
grand_man_function: Celestial inner emanation-correlation — what each emanation IS within Father.
title: The Father's emanations one beside another
